title: Adding and subtracting whole numbers
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: Add with carrying
sections.objective: Add 2- and 3-digit numbers when a column adds up to 10 or more.
explain: Line up the places: ones under ones, tens under tens.
7 + 8 = 15 is 1 ten and 5 ones. Write the 5, and carry the 1 ten to the top of the tens column.
Don't forget to add the carried 1 into the next column.

visual.caption: Tap through: watch the 1 get carried.

sections.key: Add one column at a time, starting with the ones. If a column makes 10 or more, write the ones digit and carry the 1.

sections.title: Subtract with borrowing
sections.objective: Subtract 2- and 3-digit numbers when a top digit is smaller than the one below it, including across zeros.
explain: Always take the bottom digit from the top digit, even when the top one is smaller. That's when you borrow.
Borrowing turns 1 ten into 10 ones: the tens digit goes down by 1, and the ones digit goes up by 10.
If the next place is 0, borrow from further left: the 0 becomes 10, then 9.
Check by adding: answer + the number you took away = the top number.

visual.caption: Tap through: borrowing across a zero.

sections.key: Subtract one column at a time, top minus bottom. If the top digit is too small, borrow 1 from the next place to the left.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Add and subtract 2- and 3-digit numbers, mixed together.
explain: Now the problems are mixed. Work one column at a time, starting with the ones.
sections.key: Read the sign first. Adding: carry when a column makes 10 or more. Subtracting: borrow when the top digit is too small.

hints.whole.add-sub.add-regroup: Start with the ones. If a column makes 10 or more, write the ones digit and carry the 1 to the next column.
hints.whole.add-sub.sub-regroup: Start with the ones. If the top digit is smaller, borrow 1 from the next place to the left (and if that's 0, go one more place left).
hints.whole.add-sub: Look at the sign first. Then work one column at a time, starting with the ones.

misconceptionMessages.whole.no-carry: That column added up to 10 or more. Write only the ones digit, and carry the 1 to the next column. Did you add the carried 1?
misconceptionMessages.whole.column-sums: Each column can only hold one digit. When a column makes 10 or more, write the ones digit and carry the 1 to the next column.
misconceptionMessages.whole.smaller-from-larger: In each column, take the bottom digit away from the top digit, even when the top one is smaller. When it's smaller, borrow from the next place.
misconceptionMessages.whole.borrow-no-decrease: When you borrow, the place you borrowed from goes down by 1. Did you cross it out and write one less?
